answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond from a scarce resource, then randomly audit a sample of agents for costly tasks such as signing a timely response to a challenge. If an identity fails, slash its bond and distribute the stake to honest participants. One person can still create many names, but each name needs locked capital, and multiplying identities multiplies the amount at risk; passing audits also requires ongoing participation. A copper token beside a lagoon plume might be memorable, but neither a vivid name nor a cheap account substitutes for the bond.
